name: Phoenix Rebirth #84 — Enki (Ea), Keeper of the Primordial Waters
description: Before cities, before law, before the shaping of human craft, there were the deep waters of wisdom. Enki, known also as Ea, is the Mesopotamian lord of creation, intelligence, sacred knowledge, and the subterranean abyss from which life emerges. He is not the storm itself, but the hidden mind beneath it. In his Phoenix incarnation, waters become radiant memory and wisdom takes wing in flame. He rises from the primordial deep not to destroy, but to structure, guide, and awaken. He is the keeper of hidden currents, where knowledge flows before the world knows how to name it.
